metrics.rate_scope: Whole-session aggregate mixes first native presentation loading, live warm-up, settling and requested rates; use speed_ramp.completed_stages for rate comparisons
metrics.utc_correlation_scope: Annotation for joining host telemetry to monotonic wall offsets; UTC is not a simulation clock and may move if the OS clock is adjusted

native_final_diagnostic_append_scope: All-frame timing includes evidence, validation, pending native report write/log and checkpoint/full report commit; this final timing append and result log are outside the measured interval. The committed receipt contains all validation facts and normal FPS; its own save duration is appended to this report.

native_window.evidence_policy: terminal readbacks; excluded from normal FPS, explicitly included in all-frame diagnostics

frames.budget_ceiling_scope: hypothetical 64 ticks/call at observed call rate; not claimed achieved hardware throughput

frames.quantiles: nearest rank latest 8192; maximum and mean cover every recorded frame
frames.render_filter: only normal commander recon knowledge; simulation population never truncated to fit GPU buffers

stage_cpu_wall.scope: CPU wall durations; event_gap includes OS/event scheduling; no GPU timestamps

frames.timing_scope: CPU wall + surface/present waits; GPU work is submitted, not GPU timestamp measured

speed_ramp.capacity_rule: Stop higher requests after two consecutive measured windows with <98% achieved and >4 ticks growing debt, or <90% achieved. Mixed results receive bounded confirmation; no higher rate without qualification.
speed_ramp.native_presentation_policy: After first successful GPU presentation, run the full live warm-up. Each measured window requires at least one successful native presentation and zero unpresented attempts; boundary-crossing frames are excluded. Interrupted presentation is unqualified evidence, never a GPU-capacity result.
speed_ramp.sample_scope: Stage samples exclude load, live warm-up, live settling, boundary-crossing frames and terminal captures; whole-session diagnostics include first native presentation loading and live warm-up/settling.
speed_ramp.sustained_rule: At least two full measured windows; >=98% requested rate; <=4 ticks total debt growth and <=4 pending ticks at both measurement endpoints. Inherited backlog cannot qualify a faster rate.
